text:
Mira (People Ops): Heads-up: Ben's birthday is next Thursday (Oct 14). Quick poll: breakfast burrito bar in the kitchen at 9:30 or coffee cart + cookies at 10am? both low-key. vote below :tada:
Ben: Either works for me! burritos sound dangerous (I bring the stretchy pants) :joy:
Evan: Burritos ftw. I'll bring salsa.
Ruth: Coffee cart is easier for remote folks to join virtually, also I need my 10am caffeine :coffee:
Jared: Burrito bar is fun but messy. can we do individually wrapped burritos if that helps?
Priya: If burritos, can we include a vegan option (tofu scramble)?
Noel: Coffee cart + cookies + small desk plant? ok I might be biased.
Tao: I'm remote but happy to Venmo $5 for the cart or chip in for burritos. What's easiest?
hr-bot: Reminder: shared-food policy requires clear allergen labeling and no open flames. Also coordinate with facilities for outside vendors (https://intranet.example/facilities).
Cass: I can call the coffee vendor I use for events. They do a small cart and oat milk lattes. Price ~$70 for 20 people.
Ben: Oat milk latte sounds heavenly :heart_eyes: no need for a plant tbh, just coffee and a silly card.
Mira (People Ops): Proposal: coffee cart at 10am with oat milk and cookies, plus a small e-card and optional $5 contribution. Burrito bar backup if folks prefer on-site catering. I'll post payment link and calendar invite by EOD.
Evan: RSVP: coffee cart.
Ruth: Sent $5 (https://pay.example/giftpool/ben-bday).
Jared: I'll bring napkins and individually wrapped cookies if needed.
Priya: Adding vegan cookie option to the order.
Noel: I'll grab a tiny desk plant if Ben wants one, but leaning plant-free per request.
Tao: Sent $5 via pool link.
Mira (People Ops): Calendar invite "Ben - coffee & cookies" 9:55-10:10. Card on the counter. Remote folks welcome to jump on the 2-min camera for a quick hi at 10:03.
Ben: You all are too kind 9700 thanks! short camera cameo works.
Mira (People Ops): Thanks team 7 will update if vendor confirms or if facilities asks us to move time.
